from typing import Literal, Optional
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialEntry(BaseModel):
    """A specific data point for the target asset extracted from a single document."""
    company: Literal["比亚迪"]
    item_name: Literal["其他流动资产"]
    report_period: str = Field(description="The period the report covers (e.g., 2021年第一季度)")
    data_date: str = Field(description="The specific date the value corresponds to (e.g., 2021-03-31)")
    amount: str = Field(description="The value amount including unit if present (e.g., 11,500,481,000.00 元)")
    balance_type: str = Field(description="Type of balance: 期末余额 or 年初余额")
    change_reason: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, description="Reason for change between start and end period, if stated")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_entries: list[FinancialEntry]
